name: Contextual PHP Type Evidence Wiring
changes: resourceProducer supplies enclosing resource class and declared base class context to method statement projection
context is forwarded through expression mapping, closure parameter/return type resolution, nullable parameter evidence, and nested statements
anonymous class bodies use their own context boundary and do not inherit the enclosing named class as self
static remains unsupported until late-static binding has a faithful target representation

verification.strictTypeScript: failed with 662 diagnostics across dependency graph; unrelated existing scanner/domain diagnostics also affect changed entrypoints

limitations: Resource class and parent context use the scanner's current class/base-class names; namespace/import resolution is not introduced in this phase.
Other scanner consumers without class declaration evidence intentionally remain context-free and fail closed for contextual types.
